name: paragraphs
expr: [(p.String, p.ParaBackColor, p.ParaBackTransparent, p.FillStyle.value, p.FillColor, p.FillTransparence) for e in [doc.Text.createEnumeration()] for p in iter(lambda: e.nextElement() if e.hasMoreElements() else None, None)]

name: para_styles
expr: [(n, p.ParaBackColor, p.ParaBackTransparent, p.FillStyle.value, p.FillColor, p.FillTransparence) for n in doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('ParagraphStyles').ElementNames if n.startswith('S_') for p in [doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('ParagraphStyles').getByName(n)]]

name: styled_para_style_names
expr: [(p.String, p.ParaStyleName) for e in [doc.Text.createEnumeration()] for p in iter(lambda: e.nextElement() if e.hasMoreElements() else None, None)]
